name: Chuck Schumer
role: U.S. senator from New York (1999-present); Senate Democratic leader (2017-present), majority leader 2021-2025
summary: Mainstream liberal Democrat who favors abortion rights, gun control, a higher minimum wage, taxes on the wealthy, union rights, student debt cancellation, cannabis legalization, same-sex marriage and large public investment in clean energy and technology. He supports Israel's statehood and a negotiated two-state solution, NATO and aid to Ukraine, comprehensive immigration reform alongside border security, and the death penalty for terrorism. His record on finance and trade is more mixed than his rhetoric.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Voted for the Affordable Care Act in 2009 and pushed for a government-run public plan competing with private insurers; he has backed a public option rather than a single government payer.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Declared at a rally that Democrats will fight for a $15 federal minimum wage as a matter of dignity and economic justice.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Says the very wealthy and large corporations must pay their fair share and that CEOs should not pay less than nurses and teachers; backed Biden's plan to ask the richest to pay more.

unions-good.rationale: Said unions created the middle class and that strengthening them is the best way to rebuild it; introduced the PRO Act.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Calls for guardrails and accountability on AI companies and sponsored consumer-protection measures, but a 2008 review of his record found him a prominent ally of deregulatory moves for financial firms, so the evidence is mixed.

cut-welfare.rationale: Defends Medicaid, Medicare and Social Security against cuts and calls them essential for poor and middle-class families, the opposite of cutting welfare programs.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Called the 2001 PATRIOT Act balanced and reasonable and voted to reauthorize it and extend roving wiretaps, but voted to require FISA court warrants in 2008 and against some wiretap extensions, so his record is mixed.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Introduced a bill to legalize cannabis for adults by removing it from the Controlled Substances Act, calling prohibition a limit on individual freedom; evidence concerns cannabis only and he earlier backed a drug-free America award.

limit-guns.rationale: Authored the 1994 assault weapons ban and Brady-era background-check law and in 2023 demanded a new Assault Weapons Ban, saying it saves lives.

empower-police-military.rationale: Voted to restore COPS funding to $1.15 billion and for military pay raises; his record says little about police or military authority.

rehabilitation.rationale: Voted for the First Step Act and praised its sentencing relief and rehabilitation opportunities for prisoners; sponsored second-chance programs.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Announced his support for same-sex marriage in 2009 and later spoke at the signing of the Respect for Marriage Act, citing his daughter's marriage.

abortion-legal.rationale: Introduced the Women's Health Protection Act to guarantee abortion access and calls Dobbs among the most damaging decisions in modern history.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Frames cannabis expungement and reinvestment, student debt cancellation and affirmative action as remedies for historic racial harms.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Led the 2013 Gang of Eight reform and supports legal status for Dreamers and spouses, while stressing the need to secure the border.

free-trade.rationale: Voted for China permanent trade relations and several free-trade agreements but against CAFTA, opposed NAFTA, and said globalization on balance probably raised wealth while costing tens of millions of jobs.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Voted for force and air strikes in Kosovo in 1999 and in 2017 called a limited strike to punish Assad for chemical attacks appropriate.

open-borders.rationale: Says 'of course we need to secure our borders' and has backed border security funding alongside reform.

limit-growth.rationale: Presents climate action as compatible with economic growth, citing clean-energy jobs, manufacturing investment and lower energy costs.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Pushed the Inflation Reduction Act as the boldest climate package in U.S. history and pledges never to waver on tackling climate change.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Says AI could help fight disease and hunger and ensure peace, but warns of job loss, misinformation and loss of control, so his optimism is conditional.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Voted against phasing out the estate tax and against raising the estate-tax exemption to $5 million.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Cosponsored a bill treating currency undervaluation as a subsidy that triggers duties and pressed Trump to confront China on trade, but in 2025 attacked Trump's broad tariffs as a tax on families.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Led the Endless Frontier Act, putting $100 billion of federal money into semiconductors, AI, quantum computing and 5G, and helped pass CHIPS and the Inflation Reduction Act.

right-to-secede.rationale: Was the first senator to call for U.S. support for Kurdish aspirations to an independent state after the 2017 referendum.

political-violence-never.rationale: Said 'political violence has no place in America' and that those who resort to violence must be prosecuted to the fullest extent.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Celebrates a pluralistic, multiethnic American democracy and melting pot.

taxation-theft.rationale: Treats taxation as owed fair share, saying wealthy people and corporations should pay more and taxes sustain Medicare.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Said the Jewish people have a human right to their own state like any other people and that Israel is their historic home.

school-vouchers.rationale: Opposed Betsy DeVos because her plan to privatize education would deprive students of a good public education while helping wealthy families; voted against education savings accounts.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Voted for the 2009 recovery package and further anti-recession stimulus spending.

national-self-determination.rationale: Argued that each people, Jews and Palestinians alike, can flourish only in its own state side by side.

force-without-un.rationale: Voted for air strikes in Kosovo in 1999 and backed a limited U.S. strike on Syria in 2017, both without UN Security Council authorization.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Argues clean energy is the cheapest energy and the future, and has voted against drilling in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Champions an expansive government role in health care, minimum wage, clean energy and industrial investment.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Calls for a society where all Americans are equally treated under the law and says bigotry against one group is bigotry against all.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Called claims that Jews are 'colonizers' in their ancestral homeland unfounded, absurd and offensive.

population-transfer.rationale: Called Israeli ministers' calls to displace Palestinians from their homes abhorrent and an obstacle to peace.

separated-powers.rationale: Insists the administration cannot spend funds Congress did not appropriate without its assent, and objects to waging war without a vote of Congress.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Was the original author of card check recognition (the alternative to secret-ballot elections) and sponsors the PRO Act to make organizing and bargaining easier.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Calls the country's multiethnic pluralism special and says Jewish Americans prosper alongside Palestinian Americans and every immigrant group.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Voted in 2006 to preserve habeas corpus for Guantanamo detainees and held hearings questioning military tribunals for terrorism suspects.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Says NATO must endure and stay strong and that walking away from it would be a terrible mistake.

death-penalty.rationale: Said in 2013 that the federal death penalty, which he wrote into law in 1994, is appropriate for the Boston Marathon bomber.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Backed sex education covering abstinence and contraception and funding to reduce teen pregnancy through education; gender-equality curricula are not addressed.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Backs a negotiated two-state solution with a demilitarized Palestinian state and says settlement expansion makes it nearly impossible.

collective-defense.rationale: Argues NATO matters for the security of Europe and America and that Putin's aggression requires the alliance to stand with Ukraine.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Introduced a resolution celebrating the 50th anniversary of Israel's annexation of East Jerusalem yet criticizes settlement expansion and Israeli moves toward a single state.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Told a 2010 voter survey he opposes flat-rate federal taxes and backs higher income tax rates; argues the top earners should pay more.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Warned that presidents must not be allowed to turn the presidency into a dictatorship and that America has no kings.

refugee-return.rationale: Said the Palestinian insistence on an unequivocal right of return is a fatal impediment to peace.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Called the Supreme Court ruling ending race-conscious admissions a giant roadblock to racial justice and misguided.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Argues Congress must pass the Equality Act so LGBTQ Americans are no longer exposed to discrimination in housing, education and the workplace.

minority-veto.rationale: Said the founders never envisioned an absolute minority-party veto in the Senate and pushed to let a majority pass voting-rights bills.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Sponsored legislation regulating dog breeders and received a pro-animal-welfare rating from the Humane Society Legislative Fund.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Wrote Trump in 2017 urging a block on Chinese purchases of more American companies and in 2006 offered an amendment against port operation by a firm owned by a state recognizing the Taliban.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Attacked the administration's 'Trump accounts' as a backdoor for privatizing Social Security and has long vowed to fight privatization of Medicare and Social Security.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Said spending money for a border wall without congressional appropriation would violate Congress's Article I powers.

single-official-language.rationale: Voted against declaring English the official language of the U.S. government in 2007.

corporate-influence.rationale: Says Citizens United gave massive corporations outsized power and 'disfigured our democracy,' and pushed the DISCLOSE Act to expose dark money.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Condemned antisemitic tropes of Jewish disloyalty and coded words such as 'globalists' as encouraging bigotry.

religious-nation.rationale: Describes America as a pluralistic democracy where Jews prosper alongside Muslims and every other immigrant group, and condemned Trump's proposed Muslim ban.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Says Jews have an ancient tie to the land but that both Jews and Palestinians have long historic claims, favoring one state for each.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Cites relatives killed by Nazis in the Holocaust and condemned Mahmoud Abbas's Holocaust denial.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Sponsors the Equality Act and the Respect for Marriage Act and calls for ending discrimination against LGBTQ people.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Condemned the administration's campaign against critics and civil society as an assault on free speech and 'the road to autocracy.'

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Pushed the Equality Act, which bars discrimination based on gender identity, and says Republican attacks on trans Americans infringe their rights.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Protested the Muslim ban and says Palestinian Americans and others prosper in the American melting pot.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Brought to passage the law ending forced arbitration for sexual harassment and assault claims, calling it an outrage that victims are forced to keep quiet; the law does not directly address NDAs.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Voted for military pay raises and arming Ukraine and says American security depends on NATO.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Insists that America's security depends on NATO and urges the president to preserve the alliance against Russia.

racial-franchise.rationale: Pushed the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act against voter suppression, quoting Dr. King's call to 'give us the ballot.'

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Sponsored the bill to repeal Don't Ask, Don't Tell and reinstate discharged gay service members.

abolish-ip.rationale: Wants AI companies held accountable for using creators' intellectual property without credit and compensation, and sponsored the PROTECT IP Act against online copyright infringement.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Cosponsored a Senate resolution acknowledging the Armenian Genocide.

anonymous-payments.rationale: In 2011 joined Joe Manchin in urging a crackdown on Bitcoin because its untraceable transactions facilitated illegal drug trade.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Voted for the 2002 Iraq war authorization and for force in Kosovo.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Backs the PRO Act so workers can bargain for better wages, benefits and conditions, and cites more NLRB funding as progress.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Opposed a constitutional amendment requiring a balanced budget.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Spent his time as majority leader urging President Biden to cancel $50,000 of student debt per borrower, calling it right for the economy and racial equity.

voter-id.rationale: Voted against requiring photo ID to vote in federal elections and has said photo ID requirements suppress the vote.

notes: Many roll-call votes (Iraq 2002, Kosovo 1999, estate tax, ACA 2009, stimulus) are taken from OnTheIssues and Wikipedia rather than the Senate roll-call pages, which were blocked. Senate Democratic press pages were read from Wayback Machine copies. Mixed record: voted for the 1996 Defense of Marriage Act but backed same-sex marriage from 2009; voted for the 2002 Iraq war authorization, then criticized its conduct; broke with the Obama administration over the 2015 Iran deal; called in 2024 for new Israeli elections while continuing to back military aid. Financial deregulation record (2008 NYT review) conflicts with his current regulatory stance. Senate roll-call pages for 2024 FISA reauthorization and the 2008 bank bailout could not be retrieved, so those answers are null.
